paragraphs.text: The Church by night, that is, in troubles, seeks Christ, but is not incontinently heard.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: night on my bed I sought

paragraphs.text: Showing that although we are not heard at first, yet we must still continue in prayer, till we feel comfort.
paragraphs.label: b
paragraphs.anchor: seek him whom my soul loveth

paragraphs.text: Which declares that we must seek to all of whom we hope to have any help.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: watchmen that go about the city

paragraphs.text: This refers to the Church of Israel which was led in the wilderness for forty years.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: By the bed is meant the temple which Solomon made.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: He alludes to the watch which kept the temple.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: All you that are of the number of the faithful.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Christ became man, was crowned by the love of God with the glorious crown of his divinity.
paragraphs.label: i
paragraphs.anchor: crown with which his mother crowned
